pairs.subject: drag-drop
pairs.evidence: app/foundry/pipeline/submitMoves.ts:74 Move submission awaits the authority without a deadline, so a stalled request can leave cards pending indefinitely instead of resolving to refusal with an explanation.

techniques.evidence: app/foundry/pipeline/useCardDrag.ts:96 Source cards and destination cells share one board layout, coordinate system, and PipelineSource; this interaction does not hand payloads between independent surfaces.

app/foundry/pipeline/useCardDrag.ts:105 The returned Gesture is discarded, and the hook neither retains it for unmount cancellation nor guards against another press starting a concurrent gesture; the existing common teardown therefore does not cover every required exit.

app/foundry/pipeline/useCardDrag.ts:142 Edge scrolling is proportional but uncapped: captured pointer coordinates outside the viewport produce speeds greater than EDGE_SPEED, contrary to the required capped scrolling.

app/foundry/pipeline/useBoardVerbs.ts:149 Shift+Arrow submits immediately rather than previewing a keyboard-held item; the accessible, clickable move map provides an alternative operation but does not implement the required shared grab/move/drop mode and its grab/cancel announcements.

app/foundry/pipeline/submitMoves.ts:74 Pending state and authority-confirmed reconciliation exist, but submission has no timeout-to-refusal path; the inspected article and sound HTTP clients also provide no request deadline.

app/foundry/pipeline/useCardDrag.ts:175 Item IDs are stable, but the destination is cached as numeric lane/column indices from the last pointer tracking update; decide interprets them against the latest layout, so a refresh that changes lane ordering can retarget the drop.
